title: Affine normalization of the unit integration mate
statement: In the finite-ring bundle setting [def-trf-bundle-section-orientation-data], let p be an inverse projection isomorphism with p.inv equal to the canonical projection map at the coefficient unit. If an isomorphism o:B~=L has inverse equal to the zero-section pullback of bundleSectionPurityUnitMap(p), after inverse coefficient comparison, then o satisfies the prescribed affine-frame orientation normalization. No existence, uniqueness, linear naturality or rank-zero normalization of o is asserted.

proof.text: At the coefficient unit the proper projection is the transpose of the counit, hence the identity under unitors. Open extension has the same unit equation; both signed symmetries have sign one. Thus the unit purity map is the adjunct of the actual integration trace.

On each affine frame mate naturality and the normalized compact-support exchange identify the restricted integration adjunct with the adjunct of the coordinate-tower trace. Pull back by the Cartesian lift of zero and use the section and coefficient compositors to obtain precisely the normalization equation. Integration normalization quantifies over all normalized t,D, as required. The same equations include empty schemes, zero coefficients and rank zero.
